rows.grounds: compound of nakṣatra (lunar mansion), vṛkṣa (tree), and sakala (all), taken as a whole
compound of sādhya (to be accomplished) and ākhya (called/named)
compound of karman (ritual action) and saṃyuta (joined/conjoined)

items.question: Which designated targets are to be conjoined with ritual actions in this procedure?
premises: All lunar-mansion trees are included as objects.
These objects are designated as targets to be accomplished.
The designated targets are conjoined with ritual actions.
items.inference: The procedure involves all lunar-mansion trees designated as targets together with their associated ritual actions.
uncertainties: The precise ritual role of nakṣatra-vṛkṣa in this context is not fully specified within the verse alone.
items.plain_english: All the lunar-mansion trees, designated as targets, are to be taken together with their ritual actions.
